name: howto
title: Which day? A five-step plan for Cyber Week
sub: Works for every category in this guide
footer: Sources: Adobe holiday forecast (Sept 28, 2026), store holiday calendars (Oct–Nov 2026), Target, Best Buy and Costco price-adjustment pages. Our synthesis.

items.head: Set the number
items.body: Write a price for each item before the sale. Use our good and great lines, not the banner.

items.head: Match the day to the category
items.body: Appliances and vacuums: Black Friday. Electronics and earbuds: Cyber Monday (Adobe).

items.head: Buy early where it is protected
items.body: Target matches its own lower price to Dec 24; Best Buy matches its own drops; Costco.com adjusts for 30 days.

items.head: Be careful at Walmart
items.body: Walmart.com gives no adjustment after you buy, so buy there at the low, not before it.

items.head: Check the model number
items.body: Retailer-only versions (a Shark IZ840HRW, a Little Green 3369) are not the model you compared.

items.head: Keep the receipt
items.body: Holiday return windows run to mid or late January at Target and Best Buy.
